name: mini-project1
description: > Cross-Platform Progressive Web App cho kiểm tra cơ sở vật chất khuôn viên VKU. Hoạt động hoàn toàn Offline với IndexedDB & Background Sync. Tích hợp lưu trữ Google Sheets.

scripts.copy:www: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const wd='www';if(!fs.existsSync(wd))fs.mkdirSync(wd,{recursive:true});const files=['index.html','styles.css','app.js','manifest.json','sw.js','offline.html','google-sheets-script.js','favicon.ico','generate-icons.html','generate-icons.js'];for(const f of files){if(fs.existsSync(f))fs.copyFileSync(f,path.join(wd,f));}const cp=(s,d)=>{if(!fs.existsSync(s))return;if(fs.statSync(s).isDirectory()){fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const x of fs.readdirSync(s))cp(path.join(s,x),path.join(d,x));}else fs.copyFileSync(s,d);};cp('icons','www/icons');console.log('Web assets copied to www/');"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run copy:www && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run copy:www && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run copy:www && npx cap add ios
